atoms.text: The stegosaurus and the triceratops were types of dinosaurs that lived millions of years ago. The stegosaurus lived around 150 million years ago, whereas the triceratops lived around 65 to 68 million years ago.
The stegosaurus had spines along its back and tail, while the triceratops had three horns on its head. They both measured up to nine metres long.
Both the stegosaurus and the triceratops only ate plants. The stegosaurus also ate small rocks. A triceratops weighed more than a stegosaurus and had a larger brain.
